metadata.question: Was there only snow and no clouds present in the Northern Tablelands in New South Wales, Australia on August 2, 2025?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Primary: Sentinel-2 L2A (COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED), window [2025-08-02, 2025-08-03), region ≈ Northern Tablelands (rect: [150.5, -31.8, 152.5, -29.0]).
- If empty: widen to [2025-08-01, 2025-08-03).
- If still empty: fallback to Landsat 9/8 C2 L2 (LC09/LC08), same windows.
2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- Use classification masks, not remove clouds for detection: 
  - S2 SCL: cloud = {8,9,10}, snow = 11, valid = SCL>0.
  - Landsat QA_PIXEL: cloud = bits {1,2,3}, snow = bit 5, valid = not bit 0 (Fill).
- Also compute cloud-free valid pixels to detect C2 (no valid pixels after cloud masking).
3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- If image collection size=0 after recovery attempts -> C1.
- If totalValid==0 or clearPixels==0 -> C2.
- If any reduceRegion result is null/NaN -> C3.
- A if cloudPx==0 and snowPx==totalValidPx (>0). Else B.
</thinking>

const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); # You must include this line

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const region = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([150.5, -31.8, 152.5, -29.0], null, false);
    const day = '2025-08-02';
    const win1 = {start: day, end: '2025-08-03'};
    const win2 = {start: '2025-08-01', end: '2025-08-03'};
    const scale = 3000;

    // Helper to getInfo as Promise
    const getInfo = (eeObj) =>
      new Promise((resolve, reject) => eeObj.getInfo((v) => resolve(v), (e) => reject(e)));

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check
    function s2Col(win) {
      return ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED')
        .filterBounds(region)
        .filterDate(win.start, win.end);
    }
    let dataset = null;
    let usedWin = null;
    let imgCol = s2Col(win1);
    let size = await getInfo(imgCol.size());
    if (size === 0) {
      imgCol = s2Col(win2);
      size = await getInfo(imgCol.size());
    }
    if (size > 0) {
      dataset = 'S2';
      usedWin = (usedWin === null) ? win1 : usedWin;
    } else {
      // Landsat fallback
      function lsCol(win) {
        const l9 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2');
        const l8 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2');
        return l9.merge(l8).filterBounds(region).filterDate(win.start, win.end);
      }
      imgCol = lsCol(win1);
      size = await getInfo(imgCol.size());
      if (size === 0) {
        imgCol = lsCol(win2);
        size = await getInfo(imgCol.size());
      }
      if (size === 0) {
        console.log('Dataset: None, Window tried: 2025-08-02±1d, Images: 0');
        console.log('C1');
        return;
      }
      dataset = 'LANDSAT';
      usedWin = (usedWin === null) ? win1 : usedWin;
    }

    // 3. Processing
    let mosaic = imgCol.mosaic();
    let validI, cloudI, snowI, clearI, otherI;

    if (dataset === 'S2') {
      const scl = mosaic.select('SCL');
      validI = scl.gt(0).int();
      const cloud = scl.eq(8).or(scl.eq(9)).or(scl.eq(10));
      const snow = scl.eq(11);
      cloudI = cloud.updateMask(validI).int();
      snowI = snow.updateMask(validI).int();
      clearI = validI.updateMask(validI).subtract(cloudI).max(0);
      const notCloudNorSnow = validI.updateMask(validI).subtract(cloudI).subtract(snowI).max(0);
      otherI = notCloudNorSnow;
    } else {
      const qa = mosaic.select('QA_PIXEL');
      const bit = function(n) { return qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << n).gt(0); };
      const fill = bit(0);
      const dilated = bit(1);
      const cirrus = bit(2);
      const cloudCore = bit(3);
      const cloud = dilated.or(cirrus).or(cloudCore);
      const snow = bit(5);
      validI = fill.not().int();
      cloudI = cloud.updateMask(validI).int();
      snowI = snow.updateMask(validI).int();
      clearI = validI.updateMask(validI).subtract(cloudI).max(0);
      const notCloudNorSnow = validI.updateMask(validI).subtract(cloudI).subtract(snowI).max(0);
      otherI = notCloudNorSnow;
    }

    // 4. Calculation
    const reducers = ee.Reducer.sum();
    const totalValid = await getInfo(validI.reduceRegion({reducer: reducers, geometry: region, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9, tileScale: 4}).get('constant'));
    const cloudPx = await getInfo(cloudI.reduceRegion({reducer: reducers, geometry: region, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9, tileScale: 4}).get(cloudI.bandNames().get(0)));
    const snowPx = await getInfo(snowI.reduceRegion({reducer: reducers, geometry: region, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9, tileScale: 4}).get(snowI.bandNames().get(0)));
    const otherPx = await getInfo(otherI.reduceRegion({reducer: reducers, geometry: region, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9, tileScale: 4}).get(otherI.bandNames().get(0)));
    const clearPx = await getInfo(clearI.reduceRegion({reducer: reducers, geometry: region, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9, tileScale: 4}).get(clearI.bandNames().get(0)));

    // 5. Validation & Final Answer
    console.log(`Dataset: ${dataset}, Window: ${usedWin.start}→${usedWin.end}, Images: ${size}`);

    // Null/NaN checks
    const vals = [totalValid, cloudPx, snowPx, otherPx, clearPx];
    const hasNull = vals.some(v => v === null || v === undefined || Number.isNaN(v));
    if (hasNull) {
      console.log('Calculation produced null/NaN.');
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    const tv = Math.max(0, Math.round(totalValid));
    const cp = Math.max(0, Math.round(cloudPx));
    const sp = Math.max(0, Math.round(snowPx));
    const op = Math.max(0, Math.round(otherPx));
    const clp = Math.max(0, Math.round(clearPx));
    const cloudPct = tv > 0 ? (cp / tv) * 100 : 0;
    const snowPct = tv > 0 ? (sp / tv) * 100 : 0;

    console.log(`Valid px: ${tv}, Cloud px: ${cp}, Snow px: ${sp}, Other px: ${op}`);
    console.log(`Cloud%: ${cloudPct.toFixed(2)}, Snow%: ${snowPct.toFixed(2)}, Clear px: ${clp}`);

    if (tv === 0 || clp === 0) {
      console.log('No valid pixels after cloud masking or no coverage.');
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    const allSnowNoCloud = (cp === 0) && (sp === tv) && (tv > 0);
    console.log(`All-snow-no-cloud: ${allSnowNoCloud}`);
    if (allSnowNoCloud) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.log('Processing error.');
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
